title: Arcane Oracle
description: A purple-skinned female sorceress with a gold and white mask stands behind a marble desk, levitating a glowing blue orb containing red hearts between her hands. The mystical study is filled with floating magical items including potion bottles, an open spellbook, scrolls labeled 'STASIS - DO NOT DISTURB', red candles, and a green beetle, all illuminated by a dramatic beam of light from above.
prompt: A purple-skinned female sorceress wearing an ornate gold and white masquerade mask and purple patterned robes stands in a mystical study with purple walls. She levitates a glowing blue orb filled with red hearts using both hands. On the marble desk in front of her are scrolls, red candles, an open book, potion bottles, and a green beetle. An open spellbook and heart-shaped potion float in the air behind her. Dramatic beam of blue light shines down from above, magical atmosphere, detailed fantasy illustration.
